original_test_intent: Verify the Error Operation enumeration for each SMBIOS Type 18 record—such as read, write or unknown access associated with the recorded memory error—and its valid persistence or lifecycle across reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 18 records and related Type 16/17/33/error context, retain each handle and numeric operation enum with companion error fields, interpret freshness under project policy, and repeat after an approved reboot without generating an error.
manual_activity: A user approves the expected operation/freshness policy and reboot; no memory access fault must be induced and no physical operation is intrinsic.
required_inputs: Applicable SMBIOS version and Error Operation enum mapping
Type 16/17/18/33 relationship rules and raw parser
safety_requirements: Never inject a memory error or issue a destructive access to obtain a desired operation value.
Do not clear error history, alter ECC policy or manipulate DIMMs.
Preserve raw enum, record handle and Error Type/Granularity/address context before interpreting operation.
Require approved reboot/OOB recovery; stop on invalid enum, ambiguity or boot failure and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate the numeric operation enum per Type 18 handle, correlate companion fields and read-only diagnostic context, and produce a pre/post reboot semantic diff.
Do not infer a workload or current fault solely from retained Error Operation and do not set the verdict.
engineer_actions: Define acceptable operation and retained-history semantics and approve reboot/recovery.
Assess whether the operation is consistent with the project diagnostic scenario and decide PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is correct but grep -A1 loses the raw enum, Type 18 handle, companion fields and current-versus-stale context.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full Type 16/17/18/33 raw and decoded data; report each Type 18 handle, raw/normalized Error Operation, companion error fields, relationship/freshness status and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 18 operation scope, script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no fault-producing workload is substituted.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Version-decode each Type 18 Error Operation, retain the numeric code and handle, correlate Error Type/Granularity/address and inventory context, and compare after reboot under an approved history policy.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS implementations with Type 18 error records.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, firmware, parser/dmidecode and OS diagnostic versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 18 Error Operation definitions and project record-lifecycle expectations.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw enum identity, companion-field correlation and lifecycle-aware persistence analysis.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects invalid, unsupported, misassociated or misleading stale operation values missed by text grep.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: This metadata does not identify the triggering instruction or safely authorize fault generation; causality needs a separate approved test.

project_override_considerations: A project may accept Unknown or a specific read/write operation depending on an existing diagnostic record, but it must state that policy; absence of a record is not an implicit PASS.
expected_evidence: Approved operation enum, no-record and freshness policy
Complete pre-reboot Type 16/17/18/33 raw records with handles and versions
Per-record raw/normalized Error Operation with Error Type/Granularity/address and relationship context
Read-only EDAC/kernel/BMC evidence without injection or clearing
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot semantic diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Error Operation is a defined Type 18 field; the required expected-state policy is a project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Enum decoding, record correlation and reboot comparison are fully automatable after approved inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds numeric enum, handle/companion context and stale-versus-current interpretation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Preserves no-injection/recovery controls while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates readiness and engineer interpretation from agent-executable evidence work.

review_improvement: Prevents a read/write label from being accepted without identifying the diagnostic record, raw code and lifecycle it belongs to.
independent_technical_reasoning: The field is an enumerable software-readable attribute; interpreting expected history requires input but not a manual acceptance action, and creating a fault would improperly change the source scope.
